create_layout_model: create a LayoutModel instance to run document layout prediction on pages with accelerator options
run_predict_layout: run layout prediction on a sequence of document pages and return layout predictions with clusters
download_layout_models: download layout model artifacts from Hugging Face Hub to a local directory
get_layout_options_type: get the LayoutOptions type class used to configure the layout model
draw_layout_clusters: draw clusters and cells side by side for debugging layout prediction results
